## Green Plains to Participate in 2026 Stephens Annual Investment Conference


11/16/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 93 KB](https://s201.q4cdn.com/120229500/files/doc_news/Green-Plains-to-Participate-in-2026-Stephens-Annual-Investment-Conference-2026.pdf)


OMAHA, Neb.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Green Plains Inc. (NASDAQ:GPRE) today announced that Chris Osowski, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Ann Reis, Chief Financial Officer, will be participating in a fireside chat at the Stephens Annual Investment Conference on Wednesday, November 18 at 3:45 p.m. Eastern Time (2:45 p.m. Central Time) in Nashville, Tenn. Additionally, the company will be participating in meetings with institutional investors during the conference.


The live webcast and replay will be available on the Investors page of the Green Plains website at[https://investor.gpreinc.com/events-presentations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.gpreinc.com%2Fevents-presentations&esheet=54641633&newsitemid=20261116154794&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.gpreinc.com%2Fevents-presentations&index=1&md5=d5cbe6e9a354e0f0f902508a29f189bb) .


**About Green Plains Inc.**


Green Plains Inc. (NASDAQ: GPRE) is a leading producer of low-carbon biofuels and value-added products. The company operates a disciplined, performance-driven platform focused on maximizing yield, lowering carbon intensity, and delivering value to stakeholders. Built at scale and designed to perform across market conditions, Green Plains is focused on delivering consistent performance through operational excellence and disciplined execution.


For more information, visit[www.gpreinc.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.gpreinc.com&esheet=54641633&newsitemid=20261116154794&lan=en-US&anchor=www.gpreinc.com&index=2&md5=7059febb782ab4e136c7c5160db0045f) .
